About the Scholarship

The AgriFood master trains specialists in agricultural food systems — from primary production to processing and safety — across an Erasmus Mundus consortium. The programme's pages, including the accepted-previous-studies list, describe eligibility and the next intake's timeline.

OpportunityAgriFood Master – Erasmus Mundus Master in Agricultural Food and Environmental Sciences
HostAgriFood Consortium
LocationPortugal
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month (EMJM scholarship rate)
Application DeadlineNext intake dates published on the official programme pages
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

The AgriFood master trains specialists in agricultural food systems — from primary production to processing and safety — across an Erasmus Mundus consortium. The programme's pages, including the accepted-previous-studies list, describe eligibility and the next intake's timeline.

Programme Highlights

  • Field-to-fork agri-food curriculum with European mobility
  • Accepted-previous-studies page clarifies eligible first degrees
  • Erasmus Mundus scholarship round per the live call
  • Careers in food industry, agri-cooperatives and food-safety bodies

Who Should Apply

Agricultural, food, biology and environmental graduates are the target applicants; check the previous-studies list to confirm your fit.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students per the current call.

Deadline and How to Apply

Review the accepted-previous-studies and application pages on the programme site, then follow the current call's instructions. Key deadline information: Next intake dates published on the official programme pages.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About AgriFood Consortium

The AgriFood consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in agricultural food sciences with European universities specialised in agronomy and food technology.

Official website: https://agrifoodmaster.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: See official page for dates - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
